_review: W_NEXT_NOT_LOADED: horde_horde_30-35 is written in a later phase. This band ends at Tarren Mill (Hillsbrad), where the 30-35 band is expected to start.

W_TRAINER_GAP: no class trainer lies on the Barrens, Stonetalon, Ashenvale or Thousand Needles legs (travel.json). The gap is between Orgrimmar (expected level 25) and Thunder Bluff (28); the real visit is at level 26 and 28.
Dropped 676 and 677 (Arathi ogres and Witherbark, mobs 32-35): 3+ above the level-29 expected at the end of this band. The chain continues in 35-40 (678).
W_NOT_IN_PACK: 962 (Serpentbloom) was handed over from horde_horde_20-25, where it was dropped. It is in the 15-20 and 20-25 packs, not this one.

W_BACKTRACK: the Cenarius chain (1087, 1088, 1089) needs three Sun Rock returns, and the Hillsbrad end block returns to Tarren Mill four times. Each leg is a real objective; hearths are used on the way back.
W_XP_RANGE: main and optional quests are below the 195000 budget. The 25-30 pack has few non-class, non-dungeon quests left after the 20-25 turn-ins; the drops list the rest.

Data gaps: the six Sparklematic 5200 quests (2951, 2953, 4601-4604) are elite but sit in the Gnomeregan instance (zone 721) with no spawn coordinates, so they cannot be placed or dropped. Needs a DB or validator fix.
